name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-create-notebook-glossary
title: Create Notebook Glossary
shortDescription: Creates a source-grounded, searchable notebook-style glossary from a SharePoint or OneDrive document or link, then saves it to SharePoint.
longDescription: Creates an interactive, self-contained HTML glossary from terms and definitions explicitly supported by a source document.
Presents entries in a handwritten notebook layout with sticky-note search, A-Z navigation, pastel term notes, curled-wire binding, and sketched page arrows.
Includes searchable and alphabetical navigation with organic page-turn animation and reduced-motion support, without external assets or dependencies.
Ideal for turning SharePoint or OneDrive reference documents into an engaging, reusable glossary.
